text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Ceftriaxone overdosage has been reported in patients with severe renal impairment. Reactions have included neurological outcomes, including encephalopathy, seizures, myoclonus, and non-convulsive status epilepticus. In the event of overdosage, discontinue Ceftriaxone for Injection and Dextrose Injection therapy and provide general supportive treatment [see Dosage and Administration (2.1) and ( Warnings and Precautions (5.3) ]. In the case of overdosage, drug concentration would not be reduced by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis. There is no specific antidote. Treatment of overdosage should be symptomatic.
